pre_command:
osascript -e 'tell application "Reminders" to quit' && sleep 2 && osascript -e 'tell application "Reminders" to try
set listDeleted to false
repeat with aList in (every list whose name is "Project Alpha")
delete aList
set listDeleted to true
end repeat
return listDeleted
on error
return false
end try' && sleep 2
instruction: Create a new list called 'Project Alpha' and add the following tasks to it: 'Draft proposal by Friday', 'Schedule team meeting for Monday', and 'Review budget report'.
evaluator:
osascript -e 'tell application "Reminders" to try
set projectList to first list whose name is "Project Alpha"
set remindersList to reminders of projectList
set task1Found to false
set task2Found to false
set task3Found to false
repeat with aReminder in remindersList
set taskName to name of aReminder
if taskName is "Draft proposal by Friday" then
set task1Found to true
else if taskName is "Schedule team meeting for Monday" then
set task2Found to true
else if taskName is "Review budget report" then
set task3Found to true
end if
end repeat
if task1Found and task2Found and task3Found then
return "True"
else
return "False"
end if
on error
return "False"
end try' | grep -q 'True' && echo True || echo False
